exposure: Planned mode of delivery (vaginal vs caesarean)
cohort: 98 monochorionic-diamniotic and 540 dichorionic-diamniotic twin pregnancies at a large German hospital between 2004 and 2014
finding: There were no significant differences in neonatal outcomes between monochorionic and dichorionic twins after vaginal birth.
mod_finding: Although planned vaginal birth was associated with similar outcomes in monochorionic and dichorionic twins, over half of planned vaginal twin births resulted in caesarean section.
